main_text.p: טעש לשׁ Syr. Errare, aberrare, Fut. ילטה Non aberret, ad Hebr.12.13.

טפא טפי, טפה Ch. Extinguere, extingui: Item Natare, Exo.26.28.in Jon. והוא טפי אפי מיא Et fuit natans in superficie aquarum. Significatio est à טיף, unde rectius forte legeretur טיף. Ithpeh. אטפי Extingui. Affine est Græc. τύφω.

טפי Talmud. Genus vasis, oris angusti, ex quo oleum defluit טפה אחר טפה guttatim, ut scribit Baal Aruch. Hinc forte est illud; תנורין וטפין יתרעון Clibani & lecythi vel chytropodes, Levit.11.35.in Targ.Hierosol. In Jonathane scribitur cum ת, quod vide in אפא.
טפן Ch. Saliit, subsiliit, saltavit, exsultavit: Ite, Clausit, occlusit, Jobi 5.16. Pahel טפו Idem.
טפוא Cuniculus. Plur. טפויין, טפויא. Vide quoq; טוו.
טפח Ch. Plaudere, complodere, verberare, ferire, percutere. Pahel טפח Idem.
טפוח Ch. Palmus, mensura quatuor digitorum. Plur. כתרתין טפוחין Quasi duos palmos, Gen.27.30. in Jon.
טפל טפלא Ch. Parvulus, infans. Hebr. טף. Plur. טפלין, טפליא.
טפל Ch. Concinnare, consuere, assuere, connectere, adjungere, Deut.1.1. in Targ. Jon. Ithpeh. אטפל Adjunctum, conjunctum esse, adhærere, Levit.13.4. 5.6. Jon.
טפן Τυφωνικὸς Græc. Typhonicus, turbulentus, Act.27.14. Vide notas Imman. Trem. & F. Junii.

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; some vowel points and small letters are uncertain. The final Hebrew word at the foot (טפס) is printed alone at the lower right.
